title: Stir-Fried Roast Melon with Thai Spices
description: A unique and flavorful Chinese-inspired dish that combines the sweetness of roast melon with the savory flavors of Thai spices.

ingredients.name: Roast melon
ingredients.notes: Any variety, such as honeydew or cantaloupe

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: Available in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Optional, for added depth of flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add curry paste and stir-fry for another minute.
Add roast melon and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add soy sauce (if using) and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs (optional).
